1co-1-3.anchor: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

1co-1-19.anchor: For it is written, I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, and will bring to nothing the understanding of the prudent.

1co-1-27.anchor: But God hath chosen the foolish things of the world to confound the wise; and God hath chosen the weak things of the world to confound the things which are mighty;

1co-1-29.anchor: That no flesh should glory in his presence.

1co-1-31.anchor: That, according as it is written, He that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.

1co-2-3.anchor: And I was with you in weakness, and in fear, and in much trembling.

1co-3-4.anchor: For while one saith, I am of Paul; and another, I am of Apollos; are ye not carnal?

1co-3-7.anchor: So then neither is he that planteth any thing, neither he that watereth; but God that giveth the increase.

1co-3-11.anchor: For other foundation can no man lay than that is laid, which is Jesus Christ.

1co-3-14.anchor: If any man's work abide which he hath built thereupon, he shall receive a reward.

1co-4-13.anchor: Being defamed, we intreat: we are made as the filth of the world, and are the offscouring of all things unto this day.

1co-4-16.anchor: Wherefore I beseech you, be ye followers of me.

1co-4-18.anchor: Now some are puffed up, as though I would not come to you.

1co-4-20.anchor: For the kingdom of God is not in word, but in power.

1co-6-8.anchor: Nay, ye do wrong, and defraud, and that your brethren.

1co-6-17.anchor: But he that is joined unto the Lord is one spirit.

1co-7-3.anchor: Let the husband render unto the wife due benevolence: and likewise also the wife unto the husband.

1co-7-4.anchor: The wife hath not power of her own body, but the husband: and likewise also the husband hath not power of his own body, but the wife.

1co-7-8.anchor: I say therefore to the unmarried and widows, It is good for them if they abide even as I.

1co-10-2.anchor: And were all baptized unto Moses in the cloud and in the sea;

1co-10-3.anchor: And did all eat the same spiritual meat;

1co-10-5.anchor: But with many of them God was not well pleased: for they were overthrown in the wilderness.

1co-10-8.anchor: Neither let us commit fornication, as some of them committed, and fell in one day three and twenty thousand.

1co-10-12.anchor: Wherefore let him that thinketh he standeth take heed lest he fall.

1co-10-15.anchor: I speak as to wise men; judge ye what I say.

1co-10-26.anchor: For the earth is the Lord's, and the fulness thereof.

1co-10-33.anchor: Even as I please all men in all things, not seeking mine own profit, but the profit of many, that they may be saved.

1co-11-8.anchor: For the man is not of the woman; but the woman of the man.

1co-11-11.anchor: Nevertheless neither is the man without the woman, neither the woman without the man, in the Lord.

1co-11-13.anchor: Judge in yourselves: is it comely that a woman pray unto God uncovered?

1co-11-31.anchor: For if we would judge ourselves, we should not be judged.

1co-12-7.anchor: But the manifestation of the Spirit is given to every man to profit withal.

1co-12-14.anchor: For the body is not one member, but many.

1co-12-15.anchor: If the foot shall say, Because I am not the hand, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?

1co-12-17.anchor: If the whole body were an eye, where were the hearing? If the whole were hearing, where were the smelling?

1co-12-21.anchor: And the eye cannot say unto the hand, I have no need of thee: nor again the head to the feet, I have no need of you.

1co-12-22.anchor: Nay, much more those members of the body, which seem to be more feeble, are necessary:

1co-12-24.anchor: For our comely parts have no need: but God hath tempered the body together, having given more abundant honour to that part which lacked:

1co-12-26.anchor: And whether one member suffer, all the members suffer with it; or one member be honoured, all the members rejoice with it.

1co-12-27.anchor: Now ye are the body of Christ, and members in particular.

1co-13-9.anchor: For we know in part, and we prophesy in part.

1co-13-10.anchor: But when that which is perfect is come, then that which is in part shall be done away.

1co-14-8.anchor: For if the trumpet give an uncertain sound, who shall prepare himself to the battle?

1co-14-15.anchor: I will pray with the spirit

1co-14-18.anchor: I thank my God, I speak with tongues more than ye all:

1co-14-32.anchor: And the spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets.

1co-14-38.anchor: But if any man be ignorant, let him be ignorant.

1co-14-40.anchor: Let all things be done decently and in order.

1co-15-11.anchor: Therefore whether it were I or they, so we preach, and so ye believed.

1co-15-13.anchor: But if there be no resurrection of the dead, then is Christ not risen:

1co-15-14.anchor: And if Christ be not risen, then is our preaching vain, and your faith is also vain.

1co-15-25.anchor: For he must reign, till he hath put all enemies under his feet.

1co-15-26.anchor: The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death.

1co-15-27.anchor: For he hath put all things under his feet. But when he saith all things are put under him, it is manifest that he is excepted, which did put all things under him.

1co-15-30.anchor: And why stand we in jeopardy every hour?

1co-15-38.anchor: But God giveth it a body as it hath pleased him, and to every seed his own body.

1co-15-39.anchor: All flesh is not the same flesh: but there is one kind of flesh of men, another flesh of beasts, another of fishes, and another of birds.

1co-15-41.anchor: There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars: for one star differeth from another star in glory.

1co-15-48.anchor: such are they also that are earthy

1co-16-4.anchor: And if it be meet that I go also, they shall go with me.

1co-16-14.anchor: Let all your things be done with charity.

1co-16-23.anchor: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
